record_scope_reconstruction: RoC suspension at Deryneia, Astromeritis–Zodhia and Lefka–Apliki; distinct from Ledra Street and Turkish Cypriot controls.

source_checks.finding: 29 February report names four gates closed at 06:00, including the three phase sites; other gates remained open.
Commission report indexed original extract confirms three reopened 21 June; Ledra Street excluded and testing/eligibility restrictions persisted.
Direct web access served JavaScript anti-bot wall; not treated as full document.

sites.coordinate_method: Coordinates transcribed from inspected OSM-derived Mapcarta named feature

sites.evidence_note: Named Deryneia checkpoint; north-side Derinya building W630560723 is 310 m north and distinct. This marker is the RoC checkpoint, not the town.

sites.coordinate_method: Coordinates transcribed from inspected OSM-derived Mapcarta named feature
sites.precision: approximate named crossing area; precise historical barrier footprint not surveyed

sites.name: Lefka–Apliki Green Line crossing
sites.coordinate_method: Coordinates transcribed from inspected OSM-derived Mapcarta named feature
sites.precision: approximate crossing corridor; opposite-side control point, hundreds of metres uncertainty for RoC barrier
sites.evidence_note: Named Aplıç/Lefka border-gate building 3.5 km south of Lefka town. North-side reference locates the crossing corridor, not the precise RoC control booth.

phase_decisions.phase_applicability: All three crossing identities supported, but Lefka point is opposite-side corridor reference. Not an internationally recognised interstate boundary.
phase_decisions.date_scope_check: 29 February to 21 June preserved; endpoint is conditional eligible-person access, not complete bilateral reopening.
